body:
These are places in the **A. P. de Zoysa** Sinhala translation of the Majjhima Nikāya (Mūlapaṇṇāsa, Majjhimapaṇṇāsa) that look like errors, found while reading the translation beside the Pāli.

Each item gives the file and the place in it, and a **fix** link that opens the line on GitHub (the pencil icon there edits it). Then: **Now** (copied from that line), **Should be**, **Why**, and lines from your own files to **compare**. If an earlier fix has moved the line, the search text finds it. Some items may be our misunderstanding; corrections are welcome. Please tick an item when it is fixed, or reply with its ID.

- [ ] **MPLK-001** · `vagga_1810.xml` · Satipaṭṭhāna sutta (MN 10), paragraphs 120–135 · fix: [vagga_1810.xml line 1053](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk-archive/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_1810.xml#L1053)
  - Now: (මෙම කොටසේ පරිවර්තනය සඳහා දීඝ නිකායේ සතිපට්ඨාන සූත්‍රය බලන්න)
  - Should be: The translation of paragraphs 120–135 (the four noble truths explained: දුක්ඛසච්චනිද්දෙසො, සමුදයසච්චනිද්දෙසො, නිරෝධසච්චනිද්දෙසො, මග්ගසච්චනිද්දෙසො) under their own numbers; paragraphs 121–135 (lines 1055–1102) now have their numbers and no text.
  - Why: The Pāli of the Satipaṭṭhāna sutta (MN 10) gives this section in full, and the file keeps its numbers and headings, but the translation of it is only a note sending the reader to the Dīgha Nikāya. De Zoysa translated the same section in the Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna sutta (DN 22); if his MN text is lost, the DN translation could perhaps be used here, with a note.
  - Compare, his own translation of the same section in the Mahāsatipaṭṭhāna sutta (DN 22, paragraph 387) ([vagga_1618.xml line 201](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk-archive/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_1618.xml#L201)): මහණෙනි, දුඃඛාර්‍ය්‍ය සත්‍යය නම් කවරේද? ඉපදීමද දුකය.
  - If the line has moved, search for: `(මෙම කොටසේ පරිවර්තනය සඳහා දීඝ නිකායේ සතිපට්ඨාන සූත්‍රය බලන්න)`
- [ ] **MPLK-002** · `vagga_1913.xml` · Bodhirājakumāra sutta (MN 85), paragraphs 337–342 · fix: vagga_1913.xml lines [591](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk-archive/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_1913.xml#L591), [607](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk-archive/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_1913.xml#L607)
  - Now: (පහත කොටස් අඩුය)
  - Should be: The translation of paragraphs 337–341 under their own numbers (now line 591 is only the note and paragraphs 338–341 are empty), and of paragraph 342 from its beginning (“Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno…”, the journey to Benares and the talk with the five monks) up to the point where the text now resumes (line 607 is the note “(මෙහි කොටසක් අඩුය)”, before “රාජකුමාරය, භික්ෂූන් තෙනමකට අවවාද කරමි…”).
  - Why: The file itself notes that this part is missing. The Pāli here tells how the Buddha, after the awakening, hesitated to teach, was asked by Brahmā Sahampati, surveyed the world with the Buddha-eye, chose the five monks, went to Benares and won them over. De Zoysa translated the same passage in the Ariyapariyesana sutta (MN 26, paragraphs 281–286), addressed there to the monks (“මහණෙනි”) instead of the prince (“රාජකුමාරය”).
  - Compare, his translation of the same passage in the Ariyapariyesana sutta (MN 26, paragraph 281) ([vagga_1812.xml line 595](https://github.com/pathnirvana/pitaka.lk-archive/blob/master/main/text/sinh-aps/vagga_1812.xml#L595)): “මහණෙනි, ඒ මට මෙසේ අදහස් විය. මා විසින් අවබෝධ කරගන්නා ලද මේ ධර්මය ගැඹුරුය
  - If the line has moved, search for: `(පහත කොටස් අඩුය)`
title: Errors in the A. P. de Zoysa Sinhala translation (pitaka.lk): Majjhima Nikāya, Mūlapaṇṇāsa, Majjhimapaṇṇāsa — 2 items
